sequence: Spot fixed reentry then missing-half only if no useful entrant; Coin downside two expressions then return prediction core. Single families never combined. Old applicable baselines and uniform75 reused; zero automatic795.
initial_state: cold cash, zero positions/orders; FX ingress .999; independently financed state
comparison: Single useful cost-net benefit can justify adoption, not all metrics or periods winning. Same capital/session/FX/clock wallets; no curve scaling or changed starts; all historic data developmental.
full_history: No automatic795. Only final useful entrant with unresolved whole-path adoption question and stated budget can require one candidate replay; applicable baseline reused.
joint: Only actual independent wallet sums at matched timestamps; no curve scaling/transfers. Compare real baseline, macro and signed/short alternatives when support exists.

adoption.spot_purpose: Improve BTC upside participation and net wealth, allowing moderate downside risk increase.
adoption.coin_purpose: Reduce downside losses with an economically useful preservation of profitable exposure.
adoption.coin_simple_control: Against actual uniform75 require either +.02 paired logwealth with risk no more than5% worse, or a further10% risk reduction with logwealth cost<=.05; if not, preserve simple control as practical choice, do not claim dynamic skill.
adoption.return_core: Positive cost-net opportunity support and account gain after actual costs/exposure controls; predicted/regression intercept alone never alpha.
adoption.meaning: Reference gates for finite development entry, not all-period winners, target qualification or automatic native/default certification. Preserve magnitude, treatment support, loss concentration and original failures. Any actual adoption needs supported net utility and applicable cost/path evidence.

return_core.label: i+2 open to i+9 open, actual 7day funding/cost cash proxy, mature only after exit price and all funding available

downside.sizing: original .20/(2.33*sigma*sqrt7 +gap.10+funding.01+2fees/friction), original risk7.5/3.6 and funding/stop caps preserved; new initial requested persists, no retop to old

fallbacks: predictive failure -> real independent information, no model tuning
